purpose: Document official local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: Londrina’s official SIGLON exposes a public city polygon layer with quadra/lot attributes and a declared EPSG:31982 source CRS. The bounded, unchanged WUP-point query was limited to three features and safe IDs plus geometry; it timed out with no response. This is a strong source candidate, but no exact-point feature, native ID value, geometry output CRS or sample was verified.
registryAssessment: The municipal SIGLON portal describes citizen access to municipal geospatial data. Its official ArcGIS REST service exposes a polygon layer “Base Cartográfica com Quadra, Lote e Loteamento” (layer 0), with fields OBJECTID, QUADR_C, LOTE_C, NOME_LOTE and SHAPE in SIRGAS 2000 / UTM 22S (EPSG:31982). A bounded exact-WUP point query requesting only OBJECTID, QUADR_C, LOTE_C and geometry timed out at 25 seconds with zero bytes; no feature/ID/geometry was returned or retained.
